summary: Google DeepMind reviews 15 years of games-based AI research history and describes an expanded research partnership with Fenris Creations (EVE Online/Vanguard/Frontier) and other game studios to prototype AI agents like SIMA 2 within game worlds.

practices.reason: SIMA 2 is described as a generalist agent capable of real-time reasoning across game worlds, relevant to teams building agentic systems but not a released product with stated benchmark gains here.
practices.quote: SIMA 2 acts as an interactive companion capable of real-time reasoning and conversation. It achieves human-like play across complex 3D research environments and video games including No Man's Sky , Valheim , Hydroneer , and more.
